title: Subnets file IPv6: adding subnets functionality to IPv6 much like IPv4
description:
Adds IPv6 subnet naming, mirroring the existing IPv4 subnets file feature.

Users create a file called subnetIpv6 in their profile directory with entries like:
 fd00:976a:2:129::/64 myInternalRange

 the raw address then displays as myInternalRange:0:0:0:5

AI-Assisted: yes

notes.body: @johnthacker I double checked this for leaks (lesson learned I hope). Also the hook flagged my commit for using snprintf, so I worked to changed that to wmem_strbuf. Though I see the ipv4 version of this uses snprintf, I figured I'd follow the guidance.
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 5
